title: Performance of Climate Smart Rice (var. CR DHAN 801): A Case Study from Western Undulating Zone of Odisha, India
version: International Journal of Environment and Climate Change 14(4), 80–85, doi:10.9734/IJECC/2024/v14i44098, publisher landing page with Full Article PDF link

passages.quote: During the 2023 kharif season, a trial was conducted at a farmer’s field
passages.note: The 2023 kharif trial was at one farmer’s field in Khairbhadi, Kalahandi, Odisha. It compared CR Dhan 801 in drought-prone conditions with MTU-1001 and Jamuna.
